question: 近30天销售额最高的商品有哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= date('now', '-30 day') AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY total_sales DESC
pred_sql: SELECT name, SUM(subtotal) FROM order_items JOIN products ON products.id = order_items.product_id GROUP BY name
notes: 候选示例：pred SQL 未关联 orders 表，导致取消订单未排除且缺少订单日期过滤。
